# ShopNip

> ShopNip is a local-shops marketplace for Watford and nearby, run by Suman Bros (Wholesale) Limited. Browse stationery, party, gift-wrap, art & craft, packaging and household essentials from independent local shops, order online, then collect in store (click & collect) or get local delivery. You pay the shop directly.

- Website: https://www.shopnip.co.uk
- All products: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/products
- Search: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/search?q={query}
- How it works: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/how
- FAQ: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/faq
- Sell on ShopNip (for shop owners): https://www.shopnip.co.uk/sell and https://www.shopnip.co.uk/seller.html
- Contact: hello@shopnip.co.uk
- Operator: ShopNip is a trading name of Suman Bros (Wholesale) Limited, company no. 01802958, Crown House, Otterspool Way, Watford WD25 8HL
- Sitemap: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## Brand
- Name is written "ShopNip" (one word, capital S and capital N).
- ShopNip is a product of Suman Bros (Wholesale) Limited. It is a marketplace: products are sold by independent, approved local shops, not by ShopNip itself.

## How ordering works
1. Set your postcode to see approved independent shops near you (currently Watford, Hertfordshire, UK).
2. Add items to a basket. Each basket is for one shop.
3. Choose click & collect or local delivery (each shop sets its own delivery area and fee, shown at checkout).
4. Pay the shop directly on collection or on delivery. ShopNip does not take card payments yet.
5. Click & collect orders get a collection PIN. Give the PIN to the shop when you collect; the shop checks it before handing the order over. Keep it private.
6. You can cancel until the shop accepts the order; after that, contact the shop.

## For shop owners
- Independent shops can register and list their first 50 products free, list products, set opening hours, delivery options and prices, and manage orders from a seller dashboard.
- Seller terms: https://www.shopnip.co.uk/seller-terms
